- Silvery/bronze discoloration on leaves
- Dark necrotic spots and a large dark necrotic area on one central leaf
- Small dark spots scattered across multiple leaves
- Some leaf distortion/curling

This pattern strongly suggests **Tomato Spotted Wilt Virus** (bronzing, necrotic spots). Let me verify with one reference image.

The reference image confirms the match. Both show:
- Scattered dark/purplish-brown spots across leaf surface
- Bronze/silvery leaf discoloration
- Necrotic areas developing on leaves

The test image is consistent with **Tomato Spotted Wilt Virus** — the classic bronzing of leaves plus the scattered dark necrotic spots and the large dark necrotic patch on the central leaf are all hallmark TSWV symptoms caused by thrips-vectored infection.
